# Mr² Labs — AI & Software Development Agency

> Mr² Labs builds and ships production-ready AI-powered MVPs, full-stack applications, and automation systems for startup founders in 72 hours.

## Key Services & Resources

- [Home Page](https://mr2labs.com): Core agency overview, engineering philosophy, and showcase.
- [Software Development Services](https://mr2labs.com/services): Full-stack web development, React Native mobile apps, and rapid MVP sprints.
- [App Cost Estimator](https://mr2labs.com/cost-to-build): Interactive cost breakdowns and technology stack guides for 70+ app categories.
- [Engineering Labs & AI Utilities](https://mr2labs.com/labs): Free tools including API testers, runway calculators, and prompt libraries.
- [Case Studies](https://mr2labs.com/case-studies): Detailed engineering teardowns of shipped client platforms.
- [Technical Blog](https://mr2labs.com/blog): In-depth articles on software architecture, AI agents, and startup development.
- [Client Testimonials](https://mr2labs.com/testimonials): Verified feedback from startup founders and enterprise partners.
